operating_notes.text: SEBI issued observation letter for proposed IPO of EAAA India Alternatives Limited comprising an OFS up to Rs. 15,000 million.
Board recommended a dividend of ₹1.50 per equity share for FY26.
Price band for EAAA India Alternatives IPO fixed at ₹1,585 to ₹1,665 per equity share (bid lot: 9 shares).

timeline.summary: Edelweiss Financial Services announced that SEBI issued an observation letter for the proposed ₹1,500 Cr IPO of EAAA India Alternatives Limited.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,918.1 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹87.6 Cr (-16.8% YoY).
Edelweiss Financial Services announced that subsidiary EAAA India Alternatives filed its Red Herring Prospectus for a ₹1,200 Cr IPO opening October 26, 2026.
Edelweiss announced the price band of ₹1,585 to ₹1,665 per share for the IPO of subsidiary EAAA India Alternatives Limited.
